msg: warning: Variable buf is used uninitialized!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 199501f2a00.c (BusyBox modprobe). Uninitialized value on 'buf' at line 21 ('strcat(buf, dt)'), when !def(ENABLE_FEATURE_MODPROBE_MULTIPLE_OPTIONS). However, 'buf' was initialized by 'strcpy(buf, "module option(s): ")' at line 19 — it is NOT uninitialized at line 21. The alarm about buf being uninitialized is incorrect. Note: there IS a real bug at line 21 — 'strcat(buf, dt)' where dt could be NULL (when rand()%2 == 0) — but that is a NULL pointer dereference on dt, not an uninitialized buf.
